sentences: We go through the array, starting at a[0] which is 1, not 9, so the else gives -1 and then we continue to a[1], which is 9, return 1.
First check a[0] equals 1, so skip and keep looking. Next check a[1] equals 9, match found, so return that index 1.
The loop starts at i=0, a[0] is 1, not equal, so else says not here and move on. Then i=1, a[1] is 9, so return i.
Since 1 is not 9 at position zero, the else just means keep searching. Now position one holds 9, so the answer is 1.
At i=0, value is 1, not 9, so else branch means continue looking. Then i=1, value is 9, so we return i, which is 1.
